questions: Did you suffer a head injury (such as a fall, blow to the head) prior to your hospital visit?
Are you experiencing headache or dizziness at this moment?
Did you have a seizure or convulsion (shaking/stiffening of the body) before coming to the hospital?
Did you have any episodes of losing consciousness or staring blankly?
Have your parents noticed any unusual movements or behaviors recently?
Did you have surgery recently (was the bandage placed after an operation)?
Have you had any fever or vomiting?
Is your neck stiff or painful?
Did you have a cold, flu, or any infection in the weeks before you came to the hospital?
Have you noticed any problems with your vision?
Have you had any trouble walking, balance problems, or coordination difficulties?
Has anyone in your family had similar neurological problems?
Who brought you to the hospital - was it your mother, father, or someone else?
Did someone see you have a shaking episode or spell where your body went stiff?
Has anything unusual happened to you recently that scared your family?
Do you know why you are in the hospital?
Have you been sleeping a lot more than usual recently?
Do you feel confused or "foggy" in your head?

dx_raw:
ASK:
(to caregiver, if present):
1. Did your child have a seizure - shaking, stiffening, or staring spells - before coming to the hospital?
2. Has your child been confused or sleepy since the episode?

ORDER:
1. Detailed neurological examination (assessing level of consciousness, orientation, eye movements, motor function, and tone)
2. Continuous video-EEG monitoring for seizure activity

DIAGNOSIS: Postictal state following unobserved or unwitnessed seizure (likely focal to bilateral tonic-clonic seizure)
